landing.title: Find the government benefits
landing.subtitle: Tell us a little about yourself and we'll help you discover relevant government schemes — clearly explained, in plain language.
landing.disclaimer: SchemeMate AI helps you discover schemes. Official eligibility must be confirmed with the relevant government department.
landing.howItWorks.title: How it works
landing.howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to find what you're entitled to
landing.howItWorks.step1Desc: Answer a few simple questions about your age, occupation, income, and location. Takes about 2 minutes.
landing.howItWorks.step2Desc: Our matching engine checks your profile against 25+ government schemes and shows the ones most relevant to you.
landing.howItWorks.step3Desc: Understand each scheme, save the ones you want, and track your application journey — all in one place.
landing.problem.desc: The Government of India runs over 500 central schemes plus thousands of state schemes. For many eligible citizens — especially in rural and semi-urban areas — these benefits go unclaimed simply because they don't know they exist or qualify.
landing.problem.point3: Senior citizens not receiving pensions they deserve
landing.problem.point4: Women missing maternity and welfare benefits

landing.categories.subtitle: Government schemes covering every aspect of your life
landing.featured.title: Popular schemes
landing.featured.subtitle: Most accessed government schemes on SchemeMate AI
landing.trust.title: Your privacy is protected
landing.trust.subtitle: We take your data security seriously
landing.trust.privacyDesc: Your personal information is stored locally in your browser, never sent to a server.
landing.trust.officialDesc: All scheme information is sourced from official government portals.
landing.trust.noFakeDesc: We clearly label what is a preliminary match vs official eligibility confirmation.
landing.trust.citizensDesc: Designed for citizens in rural and semi-urban India with simple, accessible language.
landing.finalCta.title: Ready to find your schemes?
landing.finalCta.subtitle: It takes 2 minutes. Tell us about yourself and discover the government benefits you deserve.
